verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's own docs describe machine learning-generated risk scores on every authorization, covering fraud risk, merchant dispute risk and card-testing detection. That is a narrow form of AI-derived insight from the user's transaction data. The MCP server is an agent-integration building block, not in-product insights, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: general AI-generated insights or analytics over spending data, AI suggestions or recommendations, evidence these appear in the Dashboard UI, independent corroboration
